avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce lorazepam levels; also GABA antagonism may counteract anxiolytic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if discontinuing St. John's Wort, monitor for increased lorazepam levels

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; both agents impact GABA receptors
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; risk of excessive sedation and liver injury

avoid_supplements.name: Alcohol (including herbal extracts with alcohol content)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Profound additive CNS depression, respiratory depression, and impaired cognitive/motor function
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication; educate patient to avoid all alcoholic beverages

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and GABA potentiation may enhance sedation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; dose adjustment of lorazepam may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild GABA-enhancing properties may potentiate lorazepam effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation; counsel on CNS depression risk

caution_supplements.name: Chamomile
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild sedative effects; potential additive CNS depression
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient to monitor for excessive drowsiness; generally safe in moderate amounts

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase lorazepam levels and prolong effects
caution_supplements.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased sedation or adverse effects

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: May delay lorazepam absorption and alter onset of action
avoid_foods.action: Take lorazepam consistently with or without food; maintain routine for predictable effect

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages (coffee, tea, energy drinks, chocolate)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine antagonizes GABA effects and may counteract lorazepam anxiolytic action
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to minimize caffeine intake; excessive amounts may reduce therapeutic benefit

monitoring_notes: Monitor for CNS depression, respiratory function, and signs of dependency with chronic use. Assess for drug-drug interactions at each visit, particularly with other CNS depressants, and counsel on avoidance of alcohol and driving impairment.
